definitionYaml:
id: order
version: "1.0"
tasks:
  - name: reserve
    call: echo
    with:
      sku: "${ .sku }"
      quantity: "${ .quantity }"
    result: reservation
    retry:
      maxAttempts: 3
      initialInterval: 1s
  - name: approval
    switch:
      - when: "${ .total >= 100 }"
        then:
          - name: review
            call: echo
            with:
              status: manual-review
            result: approval
      - otherwise: true
        then:
          - name: approve
            call: echo
            with:
              status: auto-approved
            result: approval
